title: engine.json plugins
description: The value of engine.json's plugins key: one entry per plugin instance. No plugins key means no plugins. Rules this schema cannot express are checked when the config is loaded and by basalt plugin: (name, instance) is unique, every name in agents is one of the engine's agents, config is at most 16 KiB as compact JSON and holds no credential, and auth is set only for a remote plugin. See CONTRACT.md, Plugins, Config.

instance.description: Separates entries of one plugin; default "default". Every per-plugin path, unit, OS user, socket and cursor is keyed by name and instance.

manifestSha256.description: SHA-256 of the installed manifest's exact bytes, lowercase hex.

approval.description: REQUIRED: the engine serves the entry to an agent only with a matching plugin approval signed by a person's passkey (CONTRACT.md, Plugins, Plugin approval). basalt plugin add and enable write it when they open an approval. On an agent-operated engine every entry requires approval, with or without this key. Same-user mode only: in service mode the key is refused when the config is loaded.

agents.description: The agents this entry serves. Required; an empty list serves none.

timeoutMs.description: Deadline of one call to the plugin. Default 300 for a local plugin, 2000 for a remote one.

minConfidence.description: Spans below this confidence are dropped (wire.detect). Default 0.

config.description: Opaque to the engine, passed to the plugin in initialize. At most 16 KiB as compact JSON; never a secret.

auth.description: Remote plugins only. The engine reads the file and authenticates to the plugin with it; the plugin never receives the path.
